Messages.Author: berni...@attbi.comholdlespam
Messages.Body:
Just a couple of quick questions.

1. Can Rafastio Ghoul or Talaq play Skin of the Chameleon at inferior?

2. If a Bum's Rush action is blocked, the action fails. Do I get to
draw a card to replace BR due to the action failing?

3. Order of Hermes Cabal is in combat and is placed in an Immortal
Grapple. Does he still hit for Agg?

That's it for today :-)

BernieTime

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>1. Can Rafastio Ghoul or Talaq play Skin of the Chameleon at inferior?

Skin of the Chameleon (outferior) requires Thaumaturgy. So sure, Rafastio and
Talaq can play it (paying a life).

>2. If a Bum's Rush action is blocked, the action fails. Do I get to
>draw a card to replace BR due to the action failing?

No you do not draw a card to replace, because the action hasn't necessarily
failed. (Form of Mist, etc. may continue the action).

>3. Order of Hermes Cabal is in combat and is placed in an Immortal
>Grapple. Does he still hit for Agg?

No. Order of Hermes can do 1R agg, but the agg doesn't apply to hand damage.

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"Halcyan 2" <halc...@aol.com> wrote in message
news:20020202193638...@mb-ch.aol.com...

> >2. If a Bum's Rush action is blocked, the action fails. Do I get to
> >draw a card to replace BR due to the action failing?
>
> No you do not draw a card to replace, because the action hasn't
necessarily
> failed. (Form of Mist, etc. may continue the action).

Also, you do not replace Bum's Rush until after the action has ended, the
combat resulting from a block is still part of the action, the action is not
over until it has finished resolving, which includes any combat as a result
of a successful action, or until after the combat resulting from a
successful block.
